scope: Static constructor/get_co/caller evidence only; no production AMD curve-query backend in fa39af6.

candidate_shimada_query.preconditions: GLOBAL_IS_SHIMADA nonzero; no earlier mobile identity/GPT branch that changes the argument address; query hardcodes BDF 0.

limits: The constructor can mix independent flags; the message/argument profile must not be inferred from the message name alone.
get_co has no 0x50200 initialization write in its body; this alone does not prove global initialization is unnecessary.
The old query reads the argument even after ten unsuccessful polls and ignores transport errors.
The UI displays the returned int32; this does not establish CO step size or millivolts.
CCD/core identifiers need explicit firmware binding before CPUID topology can target them automatically.
